atom_weight_structure: w(+/-3) = p3/2 each; w(+/-7) = p7/2 each (F2 landed: pit_round2.keynum_components)

fit.failure_fallback: if every nu fails to converge: use week w-1's parameters and write an INTEGRITY entry
fit.ftol_note: RULING-C1 section 1.4 states an ftol of the form 1e-<exp>; the fleet capture of the ruling truncates the exponent. 1e-12 is pinned here and hashed; confirm against the untruncated ruling at FREEZE-1 (changing it re-hashes this config).
fit.init: F2's own landed fit on the same training set (grid argmin of pit_round2.crps_keynum over BETA_GRID x P_GRID x P_GRID), run as-is
fit.nu_selection: argmin of the per-nu minimized objective; ties go to the larger nu
fit.objective: mean over the point-in-time training set of the exact discrete CRPS (pit_round2.crps_discrete) of the PRJ-1 pmf
fit.refit_cadence: weekly, at t_w = earliest emission time among week w's games
fit.training_set: every regular-season game with a final-result timestamp strictly before t_w; frozen-filter games appear as training labels only (SPEC-A 4.3)

mean_lock.method: bisection on kernel centre c_g; root of sum_k k*P(k) = mu_g

S-ALL4.definition: PRJ-1 with sigma_g multiplied by F4's per-game scale factor, normalized to mean 1 on training games; factor supplied by caller from F4's landed procedure

S-F1.definition: F1 alone: lattice homoscedastic Gaussian (pit_round2.int_support_probs at sigma0)

S-F2.definition: F2's own landed code (pit_round2.keynum_components / crps_keynum), refit point-in-time

S-G.definition: PRJ-1 with nu fixed at infinity (lattice Gaussian, hetero sigma + atoms)

theta_A_bounds_note: RULING-C1 section 1.3 imports F2's bounds for theta_sigma explicitly and states theta_A's constraints separately (w >= 0, W <= 0.5). F2's P_GRID cap of 0.08 is therefore NOT imported as a fit bound; p3, p7 carry box bounds [0, 0.5] with the joint W <= 0.5 constraint enforced in the objective. Documented reading, flagged in the freeze deliverable.
